description.value:
Frequency 2/day (+1 at 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th)

For the duration, you automatically perceive the target's true form and true location — no check required, through disguise, invisibility, or possession. At any point during that minute, you can spend this casting to trigger another Break the Anchor effect you have access to against this target at the Mirror's 60-foot range instead of that effect's normal melee or emanation range, this one time.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 'perceive true form/location, no check' clause matches real spells shipping rules: [] (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/spells/spells/rank-6/truesight.json:33, rank-2/see-the-unseen.json:33) and needs no rule element on its own. But 'spend this casting to redirect a different, already-cast Break the Anchor effect's range to 60 ft, one time' has no selector or rule-element anywhere in pf2e for overriding the range of another ability the same actor holds based on a resource spent on this one -- confirmed absent, so the combined card is INCOMPLETE even though the perceive-clause alone would be SKIP.
